# openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata ingestion pipeline by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline" "warehouse_metadata" {
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.warehouse_metadata"
}

output "warehouse_metadata_pipeline_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.warehouse_metadata.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Ingestion pipeline fully qualified name, which is <service>.<name>. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Ingestion pipeline UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `airflow_config` (String) Airflow scheduling configuration as a JSON object string.
- `deployed` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline workflow has been deployed.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `enable_streamable_logs` (Boolean) Whether the workflow streams logs back to the OpenMetadata server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is enabled.
- `logger_level` (String) Log level used by the ingestion workflow.
- `name` (String) Ingestion pipeline name.
- `pipeline_type` (String) Workflow kind such as metadata, profiler or lineage.
- `raise_on_error` (Boolean) Whether the workflow fails instead of reporting partial errors.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the service this pipeline ingests from.
- `service_type` (String) Type of the referenced service.
- `source_config` (String) Source configuration as a JSON object string.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
